pre_optimization.baseline_source: three profiled runs captured at unoptimized Batch644 checkpoint before any health-path optimization

hotspot_classification.evidence: For each board, each derivable question ID was checked with strict linear in_array against the board-owned ID list; work grew approximately with board question count times the full derivable set.

The unchanged production QuestionPoolFilter scanned all 8,856 canonical records for each of 10 boards (88,560 candidate visits), repeating normalization, runtime validation, and eligibility resolution.
Two health consumers call the same per-scan deriver; its existing per-instance card/status caches avoid rebuilding cards but repeated calls still fingerprint the same question.

optimizations.before_complexity: O(boards × derivable_questions × owned_questions) for repeated in_array membership, plus per-board card-key intersections
optimizations.after_complexity: O(boards × (derivable_questions + owned_questions)) hash membership with equivalent ordered finding lists

optimizations.id: per-exam eligibility candidate index and order-preserving candidate projection
optimizations.before_complexity: O(boards × all_questions) full runtime normalization, content validation and eligibility resolution
optimizations.after_complexity: O(all_questions + indexed_candidates log indexed_candidates + eligible_candidates) per scan; exact QuestionPoolFilter remains the final authority
